rubrics.justification: It appropriately acknowledges that no image was provided and avoids fabricating visible blastocyst features, but it cannot actually assess morphology and speculates only generally about expected Day 4 morula features.
It integrates age, ovarian response, endometrium, prior live birth/ectopics, BMI, smoking, alcohol, and male factor reasonably well, though some links to embryo quality are somewhat inferential.
The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible probability estimate tied to listed positives and negatives, though some quantitative adjustments are not strongly evidence-based.

Many recommendations are standard and evidence-based, but ERA, routine PGT-A in a 29-year-old with low-yield cycles, thrombophilia screening, and some adjunct suggestions are not broadly guideline-supported for this scenario.
It gives clear next steps for monitoring this transfer and practical future-cycle planning, though a few recommendations are more speculative than standard-of-care.
